x: Kakori event happened on 9th August 1925 A.D. In this event, 43 revolutionaries were arrested. s: Who among the following was the sole revolutionary of the “Kakori Conspiracy Case” who escaped from arrest by the police?

s: Under whose chairmanship a committee was formed to defend the accused in Kakori Case?
x: Yogesh Chandra Chatterjee was one of the founder members of Hindustan Republican Association. He was sentenced to life imprisonment in Kakori Case (Kakori train action). He wrote in his book ‘In search of Freedom’ that Pandit Motilal Nehru under Leadership of Govind Ballabh Pant formed the Kakori Case (Kakori train action day) Defense Committee. In an article by Shankar Narayan Rao at PIB website, it is mentioned that in this case President of the defence committee was Pandit Motilal Nehru. We at this moment considering Shri Chatterjee's book as a primary source consider option (b) as the correct answer. Initially, UPPSC has considered option (d) as the correct option, but later on in its revised answer sheet it supports option (b) as the correct answer.

s: On what charge was Jatin Das arrested:
x: Jatindra (or Jatin) participated in Gandhi’s Non-Cooperation Movement in 1921 A.D.
